name: x402-finance
description: x402-powered financial tools on Base Mainnet. Primary LIVE tool is get_market_data ($0.002 USDC). Agents must handle HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-SIGNATURE flow.

tools.name: get_market_data
tools.description: Fetch real-time USD prices for Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana. Use this when an agent needs current market prices. Cost: $0.002 USDC.
notes: LIVE. Requires x402 payment. Call without payment first to receive 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.
Response includes source (CoinGecko / Coinbase / cache) and stale flag.
